premises.text: Childhood obesity lacks safe tools for kids; adult calorie-counting apps and expensive clinic programs are unsuitable or inaccessible for working families
premises.evidence_span: none of these are safe for children. They all involve calorie counting, and kids are not supposed to calorie count

premises.text: Curbo is a mobile platform licensing Stanford pediatric obesity methods with red/yellow/green food tracking, challenges, avatar feedback, and weekly coaching
premises.evidence_span: Curbo is a mobile platform to enable children to eat healthier and to lose weight

premises.text: Freemium pricing offers free tracker, $35/month text coaching, and $85/month live coaching
premises.evidence_span: We're giving a free food tracker so that we can attract as many kids as we can

premises.text: Scale via insurers, hospital systems, and schools in addition to PR and social media
premises.evidence_span: we are talking to health insurers like Humana and UnitedHealthcare. We're talking to hospital systems like Kaiser and Sutter Health

value.text: Kids eat healthier, feel great, and lose weight with less family food conflict
value.evidence_span: help millions of kids worldwide eat healthier feel great and lose weight
